words.definition: Something built or arranged from connected parts.

contextSentences.en: When designing a structure, engineers must account for wind loads, earthquakes, and material fatigue.
Computer-aided design (CAD) has revolutionised how engineering structures are planned and built.

words.example_en: The structure is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Konštrukcia je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: A plan or drawing showing how something will be made.

contextSentences.en: Even in the early design phase, manufacturability and cost-effectiveness are taken into account.
Parametric design tools allow engineers to quickly create and compare many different variants.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of design yesterday.

words.definition: A complete path through which electric current flows.

contextSentences.en: Integrated circuits (chips) now contain billions of transistors in an incredibly small space.
A printed circuit board connects electronic components both mechanically and electrically.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term circuit.

words.definition: A device that detects and measures a physical property.

contextSentences.en: Gyroscopic sensors in smartphones detect the device's orientation and enable automatic screen rotation.
Pressure sensors are used in medical devices to continuously monitor blood pressure.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of sensor yesterday.

words.definition: A device that converts energy into movement.

contextSentences.en: Hydraulic actuators generate large forces and are used in construction machinery and aircraft controls.
Piezoelectric actuators enable extremely precise micro-movements in nanotechnology.

words.example_en: The actuator is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Akčný člen je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: An early model built to test a concept or design.

contextSentences.en: 3D printing has dramatically sped up and reduced the cost of producing a prototype.
Testing a prototype reveals design flaws before the product goes into mass production.

words.definition: Work done to keep equipment in good condition.

contextSentences.en: Preventive maintenance extends the life of machines and avoids unplanned breakdowns.
Digital maintenance systems allow the condition of equipment to be monitored in real time.

words.example_en: The maintenance is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Údržba je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: A machine part that supports movement and reduces friction.

contextSentences.en: Ball bearings are used in electric motors, gearboxes, and vehicle axles.
Magnetic bearings provide contactless support, eliminating friction losses entirely.

words.definition: A device that controls the flow of liquid or gas.

contextSentences.en: Safety valves protect vessels and pipelines from dangerous pressure build-up.
In hydraulics, a proportional valve controls flow smoothly and precisely.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of valve yesterday.

words.definition: The process of joining metal parts using heat.

contextSentences.en: Laser welding enables highly precise joints with minimal heat stress on the material.
Underwater welding requires special techniques that allow the process to work despite water contact.

words.definition: A detailed technical drawing of a building or machine.

contextSentences.en: Standardised blueprints ensure that components can be manufactured correctly in any country.
In a blueprint, cross-sectional views are used to reveal internal details of a part.

words.example_sk: Pochopenie pojmu technický výkres je nevyhnutné.

words.definition: A turning force that causes rotation.

contextSentences.en: The torque of an electric motor determines how well a vehicle can accelerate.
When assembling bolts, the specified torque must be applied to avoid damage.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how torque works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje krútiaci moment.

words.definition: The force or weight supported by a structure or machine.

contextSentences.en: A static load acts permanently on a structure, while a dynamic load results from movement or vibration.
Wind turbines must be designed to remain safe even under extreme load caused by storms.

words.example_en: The load is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Zaťaženie je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: The ability to work well without waste.

contextSentences.en: The efficiency of a steam power plant is typically between 35 and 45 per cent.
Losses from heat, friction, and stray fields reduce the efficiency of every real machine.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term efficiency.

words.definition: The process of putting parts together into a whole.

contextSentences.en: In car manufacturing, assembly takes place on a production line with precisely timed steps.
After assembly, every subassembly is tested to confirm it works correctly.

words.example_en: The assembly is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Montáž je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.
